description: What a send, token transfer or swap costs right now on each major chain, and which chain is cheapest. Live network fees on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB, Avalanche, Solana and Bitcoin: slow/standard/fast fee rates, congestion and trend, and the USD cost of a send, token transfer and swap on each, plus the cheapest chain now. Pick chains with chains (e.g. base,solana); all by default. Use to pick the cheapest chain, or a good moment, to send or swap. Answers may be cached for up to 15 seconds. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits); failed calls are free. In the free trial.
